Chapter 610: Chapter 36: Lin Yuan And Hunyi (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 610: Chapter 36: Lin Yuan and Hunyi (Subscribe Please)

Before Lin Yuan performed his ninth traversal, to give Xilan hope, he casually mentioned that an elder was on their way.

It wasn’t entirely a fabrication; the significance of “elder” lay in combating Hunyi. As long as Lin Yuan safely completed the ninth traversal and his strength significantly increased, he himself would be the “elder.”

In Lin Yuan’s expectations before the traversal, even without the aid of a Divine Lattice, traversing through the worlds over a thousand years could likely cultivate him to the Nine-stage Million-layer Realm.

With over a hundred million li in size of his inner world, even if there was a gap in developing Spatial Layers compared to Hunyi, his overall strength could be on par.

Not to mention that the actual gains from this traversal far exceeded Lin Yuan’s initial expectations.

“Inner world…”

...

Lin Yuan also observed his own inner world.

The return of the Spirit Will didn’t change the size of the inner world, as it needed to absorb the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd to recover to nearly two hundred million li in diameter.

However, the depth, or the Spatial Layers, was expanding at a terrifying speed; one million layers, ten million layers…

Expanding the Spatial Layers required a profound comprehension of the essence of space. With Lin Yuan’s current understanding of the spatial essence, he could restore up to 2.331 billion layers in a short time.

“Let’s go out,” Lin Yuan looked up, and with his current mastery of the Spatial Layers, even with the separation by Xilan’s inner world, he could easily see the outside.

“Go out?”

Xilan was somewhat confused. Could it be that Lin Yuan’s said “elder” had arrived?

But Xilan hadn’t sensed any approaching Ninth Rank powerhouse’s aura. Although there were many Ninth Rank members of different species watching from afar, their revealed aura didn’t seem capable of holding off a special Ninth Rank like Hunyi?

The next moment.

Under Xilan’s gaze.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared from the spot.

“Did the Galaxy Master go out?”

Seeing this, Xilan was a bit slow to react.

In his inner world, without his permission, the Galaxy Master had gone out?

One must know… As the opener of the inner world, Xilan was like a creator god within it.

He could control all the powers of the inner world. Even for someone as powerful as Hunyi, who had developed over thirty million Spatial Layers, if he was deeply trapped in Xilan’s inner world,

Without Xilan’s consent, the only possibility to get out would be to forcefully shatter the inner world.

As for leaving silently? Perhaps Eleventh or Tenth Rank powerhouses could achieve it, as their understanding of the spatial essence had reached inexplicable levels, enabling them to disregard Xilan, the world’s opener.

But how did Lin Yuan get out?

Xilan couldn’t understand and was unable to figure it out, but immediately afterwards, he realized something.

That was, the Galaxy Master had gone out, and outside was Hunyi, the strongest Ninth Rank of the Tianyu Clan, pursuing to kill.

Without Xilan leading Lin Yuan to escape, the Galaxy Master would probably be captured by Hunyi in an instant.

“Not good.”

Xilan’s avatar within the inner world dissipated.

Outside.

Xilan was using various escape methods derived from the void evolution path, sliding through gaps between Spatial Layers to elude Hunyi as much as he could.

At that moment—

Whoosh.

Beside Xilan, Lin Yuan’s figure suddenly appeared.

Hunyi, who was pursuing, paused slightly, then was overjoyed.

If Lin Yuan had continued to hide in Xilan’s inner world, he might have extended his survival for a while under his pursuit.

But to come out voluntarily? Especially since Lin Yuan, after coming out, wasn’t continuing to flee but was standing quietly there.

Whoosh.

Similarly, Xilan, who had initially fled far away, returned to Lin Yuan’s side.

“Galaxy Master…” Xilan’s expression was grave. He could keenly sense that the moment they stopped, Hunyi took the opportunity to completely seal off all surrounding Spatial Layers.

That is, Xilan and the Galaxy Master, like turtles in a jar, were completely at Hunyi’s mercy.

At the same time.

The many Ninth Rank members of different species watching from afar also noticed that the Galaxy Master was making no attempt to escape actively.

“Has the Galaxy Master given up hope? Doesn’t he even want to run?”

“It seems so. Actually, it should have been like this from the beginning. With Hunyi’s pursuit, if there were no similarly ranked human evolvers nearby, escape would just be a death sentence, completely a waste of time.”

“Right, if he had detonated his avatar at the start of the pursuit, maybe his second incarnation would be half-formed by now.”

The multitude of Ninth Rank members from different species discussed animatedly, still showing no signs of dispersing. Seeing the demise of a supreme talent of human civilization, even if it was just an avatar, was quite a rare event.

Human civilization highly valued talents. Most of the time, talents were fiercely protected, even on the Battlefields of Different Races, where high-rank evolvers would pay special attention.

But in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm? The Xuanhuang Secret Realm has a unique origin, forbidding Tenth Rank and above powerhouses from entering, not even Supreme Beings could peek inside.

Here, the talents of human civilization had to face many dangers independently.

Like now, the Galaxy Master faced the pursuit of Hunyi.

“The critical moment is approaching.” In the depths of the Spatial Layers, Maduo Traveler also grew tense. He raised his right hand, where a vortex resembling a black hole was slowly rotating.

This life-saving trump card, created by Maduo Traveler’s Ancient God Ancestor, contained elements of the Rule of Time.

Maduo Traveler’s Ancient God Ancestor, immensely ancient, had long mastered the complete Rule of Time. Even so, to create this life-saving trump card, he had paid a considerable price.
